title: This Tested VWAP Scalping Trading Strategy is AMAZING! (MUST WATCH)

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a stock to break above the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) after being below it at the opening bell.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break above VWAP is a milestone level that signals strength and attracts other traders.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a pullback to the VWAP area after the initial move above VWAP.
entry_sequence.rationale: Experienced traders are waiting for pullbacks to buy into, as buying at the high of the day can lead to being faked out.

entry_sequence.action: Enter long on the pullback to the VWAP, anticipating a bounce at the VWAP level.
entry_sequence.rationale: The VWAP is used as a milestone level and support area because many other traders are using it as such.
